title: CJP protest in Delhi LIVE: CJP shares video of massive crowd ahead of protest, says ‘Jantar Mantar gearing up’
description: CJP protest in Delhi LIVE: The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) is set to hold its second major protest at Jantar Mantar in the national capital today, stepping up its campaign demanding Union education minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation. Activist Sonam Wangchuk is expected to attend the protest.
